review_round_1.finding: P2: message 68 could copy synthetic modifier unit_id/centre_id, including during expiration
review_round_1.change: broadcast_powerup_modifier now rejects either nonzero target ID before its operation-specific binding check, for insertion and expiration alike. False preserves PowerupManagerBinding::send_powerup_message68's existing observation fallback. Native modifier packets are admitted only when unit_id and centre_id are both zero; operation-zero bound-item restrictions still apply.
review_round_1.validation: Win32 build and all four existing CTest checks passed. The focused probe rejects nonzero unit_id and nonzero centre_id separately for operations 0 and 2, and accepts the supported zero-ID expiration. All three claimed rows remain entry-reachable; called-address total remains 5751.

rows.reason: 008E6E00 constructs the real unbound inventory item's slot, class name, use limit and operation; 007657D0 releases its owned native pool string after the host-only zero-peer send. Bound-entity and unresolved-class sends remain unsupported; no synthetic entity IDs or receive loopback were added.

008E6FB0 copies the actual modifier's complete native prefix and name; 007658C0 releases its owned pool string. Both insertion and expiration require unit_id == 0 and centre_id == 0 because nonzero resolver values are synthetic. Insertion additionally requires no binding needing a native unit+174h. Rejected target/binding cases retain the existing observation fallback.

The required mission caller lease became available during foreground retries. The existing 00771190 body now constructs NativeSessionMessage09 and its owned pooled name from the actual selected scene, index and content mask. 007662A0 frees the packet after the host-only zero-peer broadcast, without a local scene-selection replay.
